prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
competitors_mentioned: Arizona Periodontal Group / Dr. Ariel Trujillo
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable way to name one “best” dentist without knowing your case, budget, and location within Phoenix. For an implant, I’d start by consulting a **board-certified periodontist or oral and maxillofacial surgeon**—especially if you may need bone grafting or have gum disease—and get a separate estimate for the final crown.

A couple of Phoenix options to compare:

- **AZPerio** — board-certified periodontists; Phoenix locations and implant-related procedures including grafting. [azperio.com](https://azperio.com/dental-implants/)
- **Arizona Periodontal Group / Dr. Ariel Trujillo** — Phoenix periodontist who lists board certification and implant treatment. [periodontistphoenix.com](https://www.periodontistphoenix.com/)

Before choosing, verify the clinician’s current specialty credentials, ask who places the implant and who makes the crown, and request a written treatment plan with the total cost, alternatives, and follow-up/maintenance. A second opinion is worthwhile if the plan involves multiple implants or full-arch treatment.
